newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Injunction puts auction of Rio gas firms on hold.
newsitem.headline: Injunction puts auction of Rio gas firms on hold.

text.p: The privatization auction of Rio de Janeiro state gas firms Companhia Estadual de Gas (CEG) and Riogas remains scheduled for 1000 local/0900 EDT/1300 GMT, said a spokeswoman for the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.
But the sale depends on whether the state will succeed in having a court injunction blocking the sale overturned by the auction's scheduled time, she added.
Another five lawsuits have been filed against the privatization, press reports said.
CEG is being sold at a minimum price of 423 million reais, while the base price for Riogas is 141 million reais.
Newspapers said 25 companies grouped in six consortia will take part in the first auction of a state-owned gas company.
Investors will have to present individual offers for both companies and whoever places the highest combined bid for both gas firms will win.
